operator_constraint: All byte transfer is performed by the cloud VM. The operator's workstation downloads no file bytes, so this tool reads metadata only and derives every authority from published integrity ids.
why_this_manifest_exists: The Mooncake GPU host cannot reach the HuggingFace origin, so bytes are fetched there through a mirror. Mirrored bytes are only trustworthy when checked against an authority obtained from the origin, which is what this manifest supplies.

authority_kinds.lfs_sha256: content SHA-256, compared directly against the host-computed digest
authority_kinds.git_blob_sha1: SHA-1 over b'blob <len>\0' + content, recomputed on the host
